## Most common haplotypes
Those sequences with the major number of bases and less gaps that 
belongs to either the first or the second haplotype were selected for 
the Crepidostomum genus phylogenetic reconstruction. 
Additionally, Ignasi created a list with the belonging of the samples
to the species C. farionis and C. pseudofarionis. I make sure that the 
haplotypes I choose for each of the lakes are pure for one of the two species.
```{r}
suppressWarnings(library(stringr))
suppressWarnings(library(Biostrings))

hapList <- read.table('../2024-01-18/hapList.txt', header = TRUE)
hapList <- hapList[-c(which(is.na(hapList$freq))), ]
hapList$Accession[1:3] <- str_split(hapList$Accession[1:3], ";")

SpAdm <- read.table("../2024-10-05/summary.txt", header=TRUE)
far <- SpAdm[which(SpAdm$K2.1 > 0.99),"Sample"]
pse <- SpAdm[which(SpAdm$K2.2 > 0.99),"Sample"]

setdiff(hapList$Accession[2][[1]], far)
#setdiff(far, hapList$Accession[2][[1]])
#L087Cxa
setdiff(hapList$Accession[1][[1]], pse)


## In LAN = farionis
## In SUO = pseudo
```
Only one sample differs from the admixture. We upload the 
alignment for the COI from all samples, and I gonna choose 
those sequences with more data. 
```{r}
CrepiCOI <- readDNAStringSet("../2023-10-02/GB/Cox1_Cfar_ASM_align.fa-gb1")
CrepiCOI <- CrepiCOI[names(CrepiCOI)[-grep("S031Cmc", names(CrepiCOI))]]
far1 <- names(CrepiCOI)[49] # I wnt to see the mtching with two samples of different lake but same sp.
Freq <- alphabetFrequency(CrepiCOI)
Freq <- which(Freq[,15] > 0) # 15 = N, 16 = Gaps
CrepiCOI <- CrepiCOI[-Freq]

far2 <- intersect(names(CrepiCOI), hapList$Accession[2][[1]])[3]
pse1 <- intersect(names(CrepiCOI), hapList$Accession[1][[1]])[1:2]
writeLines(c(far1, far2), "farionis.txt")
writeLines(pse1, "pseudo.txt")
```


## Extraction of markers from the most common haplotypes

```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
if [ ! -d SampCOI_farionis ]; then mkdir SampCOI_farionis; fi
for i in $(cat farionis.txt); do
  if [ ! -e SampCOI_farionis/${i}_28S.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_Cox1_Cfar_ASM/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r Cox1_Cfar_ASM $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>Cox1_Cfar_ASM/>${i}/" >> SampCOI_farionis/${i}_COI.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e farSamp.fa ]; then cat SampCOI_farionis/*.fa > farSamp.fa; fi


if [ ! -d SampCOI_pseudo ]; then mkdir SampCOI_pseudo; fi
for i in $(cat pseudo.txt); do
  if [ ! -e SampCOI_pseudo/${i}_28S.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_Cox1_Cfar_ASM/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r Cox1_Cfar_ASM $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>Cox1_Cfar_ASM/>${i}/" >> SampCOI_pseudo/${i}_COI.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e pseSamp.fa ]; then cat SampCOI_pseudo/*.fa > pseSamp.fa; fi
```


## Obtain the Cox1 sequences of GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt ]; then
   ## COI
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22coi%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
   ## COX1
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22cox1%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessions.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessions.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa
fi
```

# Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
CrepiENA <- readDNAStringSet("Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa")

for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiENA))) {
  name <- paste0("C._", strsplit(names(CrepiENA), " ")[[i]][3])
  accession <- substr(strsplit(names(CrepiENA), " ")[[i]][1], 5, 12)
  names(CrepiENA)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name)
}

### Keep only one sequences for sp
names(CrepiENA)[(grep("illinoiense", names(CrepiENA)))]
CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("illinoiense", names(CrepiENA))[c(1:6,8:9)]]
names(CrepiENA)[(grep("affine", names(CrepiENA)))]
CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("affine", names(CrepiENA))[c(1,3:4)]]
names(CrepiENA)[(grep("metoecus", names(CrepiENA)))]
CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("metoecus", names(CrepiENA))[c(1:2)]]
names(CrepiENA)[(grep("auriculatum", names(CrepiENA)))]
CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("auriculatum", names(CrepiENA))[2]]
names(CrepiENA)[(grep("auritum", names(CrepiENA)))]
CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("auritum", names(CrepiENA))[2]]

CrepiENA <- CrepiENA[-grep("isostomum", names(CrepiENA))]

#BrowseSeqs(AlignSeqs(CrepiENA), htmlFile = "Align_ENABrowser.html")

writeXStringSet(CrepiENA, "CrepiENA_CoxEdited.fa")

```
### Modifying the names of the sequences and adding some information
```{r}
CrepiENA2 <- readDNAStringSet("CrepiENA_CoxEdited.fa")
info <- read.delim("Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt", header = TRUE)
rownames(info) <- info$accession

accessions <- character()
for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiENA2))) {accessions[i] <- strsplit(names(CrepiENA2), "_")[[i]][1]}
info <- info[accessions, ]

for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiENA2))) {
  name <- paste0("C._", strsplit(names(CrepiENA2), "_")[[i]][3])
  accession <- strsplit(names(CrepiENA2), "_")[[i]][1]
  #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 2], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 2], " ")[[1]][2])
  country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
  names(CrepiENA2)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
}

writeXStringSet(CrepiENA2, "CrepiENA_CoxEdited2.fa")
```


## Obtain the two outgroups for the phylogeny 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
## Allocreadium gotoi
if [ ! -e Genbank/accessionAG.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=LC215273&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionAG.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionAG.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
if [ ! -e Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa ]; then 
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_Allocreadium_gotoi" Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa

## Allocreadium khankaiensis
if [ ! -e Genbank/accessionAK.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=MW729428&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionAK.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionAK.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
if [ ! -e Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa ]; then 
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_Allocreadium_khankaiensis" Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa

```

# Reconstruct the phylogeny 

First, align and visualize the sequences (with R and Mafft)

```{r, collapse=TRUE}

CrepiENA <- readDNAStringSet("CrepiENA_CoxEdited2.fa")
Outgroups <- readDNAStringSet("Outgroups.fa")

FAR <- readDNAStringSet("farSamp.fa")
PSE <- readDNAStringSet("pseSamp.fa")
#Cox_RefGen <- readDNAStringSet("Cox1_RefGen.fa")

Sequences_tree <- c(CrepiENA, FAR, PSE, Outgroups)
writeXStringSet(Sequences_tree, "Sequences_treeR.fa")
#BrowseSeqs(AlignSeqs(Sequences_tree))
```

### Align the sequences with mafft
```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
if [ ! -d RAxML ]; then mkdir RAxML; fi
if [ ! -d $FOLDER ]; then mkdir $FOLDER; fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg ]; then
  mafft --maxiterate 1000 --thread 24 --localpair Sequences_treeR.fa > $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg
fi
```
#### Trimm the alignment
```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
#if [ ! -e AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1 ]; then
  Gblocks $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg -t=d -b1=9 -b2=11 -e=-gb1 -d=y -v=1000 -b5=h
  #mv $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1 $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_02.alg
#fi
```

```{r}
if (file.exists("RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg") == FALSE) {
  Align <- readDNAStringSet("RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1")
  #BrowseSeqs(subseq(Align, start = 97, end = 241))
  #Align <- subseq(Align, start = 173, end = 320)
  writeXStringSet(Align, "RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg")
}
```

### Reconstruct the tree
```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01

if [ ! -e T1_1000.raxml.support ]; then 
  raxml-ng --all --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T1_1000 --bs-trees 1000 --threads 48
fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/EvalMod_GTR+R4.raxml.log ]; then 
  for i in GTR+G GTR+R4 GTR JC JC+G; do
    raxml-ng --evaluate --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --tree $FOLDER/T1_1000.raxml.bestTree --model ${i} --prefix $FOLDER/EvalMod_${i}
  done
fi

# Which model yields the highest log-likelihood? 
grep "logLikelihood" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
## The model is GTR+R4, but
# AIC/BIC scores (lower values are better)
grep "AIC" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
## Finally run a tree Search
raxml-ng --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T2 --threads 48 --redo

## Compute and map bootstrap support values to the best ML tree (S1.raxml.bestTree)
raxml-ng --bootstrap --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/S2_bestTree --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --threads 48 --bs-trees 10000
# Recompute support values using the Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) algorithm. Did this change the support values?
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_FBP --threads 48 --bs-metric fbp
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_TBE --threads 48 --bs-metric tbe

```
